action: I ask Halloway to set an exact deadline for the registers: would 10 AM today work? I wait for her answer before making any promise.

narrative.text: You lean in slightly, keeping your voice professional. "Agent Halloway, to ensure everything is organized and complete, would a 10:00 AM deadline for those registers work for you?"

Halloway doesn't blink. She slowly turns her head to look at the clock on the wall, then back to you. A thin, joyless smile touches her lips, though it doesn't reach her eyes. "Ten o'clock," she repeats, her nasal tone flattening. "That is precisely fifty-eight minutes from now. I find your optimism... refreshing. Yes. Ten o'clock. If they aren't on my desk by then, I'll simply start my audit with the records I *do* have, and I'll make a very detailed note regarding the branch's inability to produce basic documentation."
